user.title: Shelly Extras
user.description: Add the Shelly Extras actions to Home Assistant. No configuration is required.

abort.already_configured: Shelly Extras is already set up.

no_properties.message: Specify at least one property to set (brightness, color temperature or color).

no_shelly_lights.message: No Shelly lights were found in the selected target. This action only works on lights from the core Shelly integration.

set_light_properties.name: Set light properties
set_light_properties.description: Changes brightness, color or color temperature of Shelly lights without changing their on/off state. If a light is off it stays off; the new values apply the next time it turns on.

color_temp_kelvin.name: Color temperature
color_temp_kelvin.description: White color temperature in Kelvin. Applied to lights that support color temperature.

rgb_color.name: RGB color
rgb_color.description: Color as a list of red, green and blue values (0-255 each).

rgbw_color.name: RGBW color
rgbw_color.description: Color as a list of red, green, blue and white values (0-255 each). Applied to RGBW lights.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration, in seconds, over which to fade to the new values.
